purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically undoes one exact self-scoped unschedule only while the Schedule is still absent and has no later placement history, creating a new immutable floating-local placement state and a new current-history episode.

routine.return_type: TABLE(schedule_ref uuid, restored_from_material_state_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, starts_local_at timestamp without time zone, ends_local_at timestamp without time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Copies prior floating-local interval semantics into one new immutable schedule.placement MaterialStateRef.
state_history.current_binding: Requires continued absence and no later history, then inserts one new explicit current binding and open history episode.
state_history.chronology: The new episode starts strictly after the unschedule boundary; no prior history row is reopened.
state_history.immutability_policy: Same operation and exact receipt intent replay the new state; later chronology or different intent conflicts.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Routine removal is migration-only and downgrade fails closed after B02-D operation receipts exist.

obligations: function is dante_owner SECURITY DEFINER with trusted search_path
runtime has EXECUTE only and no direct receipt/state/current/history DML
Undo is scoped to the authenticated self and exact unschedule receipt
continued absence plus no later history episode are required
accepted Undo creates a new MaterialStateRef and history episode and never reopens the old row
